race.title: Weatherite Air Conditioning Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: On the back of an encouraging reappearance at Ascot 2 weeks ago, SHAKEYATAILFEATHER is perched just 1 lb above her last winning mark, gained at Kelso around this time last year and she looks primed to strike. Highlands Legacy won on last season's return to the track and represents a yard in excellent order so he's a definite threat, along with Authoceltic . SHAKEYATAILFEATHER (IRE) HIGHLANDS LEGACY AUTHOCELTIC (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Larzac (3/1), Shakeyatailfeather (7/2), Highlands Legacy (9/2), Authoceltic (11/2), Putapoundinthejar (7/1), Boothill (9/1), Tour Ovalie (9/1), Femme Magnifique (14/1), Classic Maestro (20/1), Jony R (20/1)
